hook: Why your AI emails sound *so generic*
hookSub: Same task. Two prompts. Watch the difference.

rounds.title: What most people type
rounds.prompt: Write an email asking for a raise
answer: I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to respectfully request a review of my current compensation...

rounds.title: Type *this* instead
rounds.prompt: I'm a project coordinator, 2 years here. I led our vendor switch that cut costs 12%. Write a short, confident email asking my manager Dana for 20 min to talk about my pay. Under 80 words.
answer: Over the past 2 years my role has grown, including leading our vendor switch that ==cut costs by 12%.==
==I'd love 20 minutes next week to talk about my pay== and where I can grow next.

endBig: Comment *TEAM* for 5 more prompts like this
caption:
Why your AI emails sound so generic 🤖

It's not the AI, it's the prompt. Give it 3 things and the answer gets way more useful:
1️⃣ Who you are
2️⃣ The details only you know
3️⃣ What you want (tone + length)

Copy this prompt 👇
"I'm a [your role]. [1-2 key details]. Write a short, confident email to [person] asking for [what you want]. Under 80 words."

Comment TEAM and I'll send you 5 more prompts like this for work 📩
